stem.text: A beam of light from a laser is incident normally on a diffraction grating.

stem.alt: Light beam incident from the left on a diffraction grating, with two diverging rays leaving on the right; labels: light beam, diffraction grating, 110°.

stem.text: The diagram shows only the **second**-order maxima that are produced.
The grating has a line spacing of $1.0 \times 10^{-6}\,\text{m}$. The angle between the two second-order maxima is $110^{\circ}$.
What is the wavelength of the light?
